description: Runs a task declared in while.yaml now, outside its schedule; it does what its code does.

approval_id.description: Approval granted, when the organization requires an approval for tasks in production.

args.description: Arguments appended to the command, for example ["--since", "2026-10-12"].

catch_up.description: Period to catch up: the run is counted "catch_up" and receives it as variables.

end.description: End of the period (included); the start by default.

start.description: Start of the period: 2026-10-12, or an ISO 8601 instant.

env.description: Extra variables for this run only.

name: run_task
title: Run a job
